🔥 logo-design-skill | HTML
🎯 Primary Use Case: To empower AI agents to perform disciplined identity design and create professional logo assets.
✨ Key Features: • Covers logo design principles and process from brief to delivery. • Includes a searchable library of 1,400+ SVG logos classified by various attributes. • Provides dependency-free Python tools for auditing SVGs, creating test sheets, client presentation boards, and exporting icon sets.
📖 Summary: This repository provides a comprehensive logo design skill for AI agents like Claude, Gemini CLI, and Codex. It guides users through the entire logo design process, from initial brief to production-ready SVG files and brand guidelines, incorporating design principles and a large reference library.
